• (01:01) - Anthropic Slips After Historic IPO
  • (01:36) - Math Solved Again
  • (07:22) - Market Nukes
  • (10:11) - Lenders Push Back on SpaceX Chips
  • (17:33) - 𝕏 Timeline Reactions
  • (24:48) - THE MANSION SECTION
  • (29:36) - Alex Epstein discusses the urgent need for bipartisan permitting reform to expand America’s freedom to build energy infrastructure, housing, and AI data centers. He argues that the proposed legislation could lower costs and create jobs by removing regulatory barriers, while emphasizing that Congress has only a narrow window to pass it. He also champions widespread AI and energy development while criticizing tariffs and restrictions on overseas data-center construction.
  • (59:11) - David Chang is a renowned chef, restaurateur, and media personality known for founding Momofuku. David Chang discusses his Las Vegas F1 pop-up, his CNN series The Detour, the challenges of the food business, and the need for greater originality and innovation in restaurants.
  • (01:22:23) - Zhou Xian discusses Genesis AI’s mission to build general-purpose robots with human-level capabilities by jointly developing robotic intelligence and hardware. He explains the company’s focus on learning from human hand movements and deploying robots in high-value manufacturing, logistics, and laboratory applications, while noting its $500 million funding round.
  • (01:29:35) - Eric Wind discusses his journey from international politics and watch journalism to founding Wind Vintage and publishing *Vintage Watches: The Modern Guide*. He explores the appeal and trade-offs of vintage watches, the quartz crisis, independent watchmakers, market speculation, and the growing problem of counterfeit luxury watches.
